main_text.l: Et sic Romanus Pontifex, qui aliorum iu-
dex in Concilijs sedere debet, post Photium
sedens iudicabitur; & etiam si iusta non ius-
tur. Romani iussa, atque sententiae grauis-
quia ille neque aequum, neque iustum po-
uertitur. Et ego dicam Synodum similia
& genuinam esse? Non sum stipes, nec
fungus. Alia ab his & longe diuersa genuina
ad Imperatorem Basilium lecta in Octaua

page.notes: The Greek passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Words I could not read letter by letter are marked [?] or as illegible, and I have not filled them from memory. The Latin is clear except where noted. The long s is transcribed as plain s (e.g. "iussisse", where the printed form is a ligature-like s/f). The catchword "nu-" sits at the lower right of the page. Stray marks at the foot of the scan are ink specks, not text, and are left out.
